title: Quintom Dark Energy (Feng, Wang, Li)
efc_relevance: Two-field construction (canonical + phantom) that crosses the w = −1 divide. DESI DR2 quintom A/B analyses (arXiv:2601.02284) are directionally compatible with EFC's L2→L3 transition — both models can produce phantom-crossing without ghost instabilities at the background level. Discriminator: EFC predicts correlated μ(a)<1 at perturbation sector, quintom does not.
ledger_action: Logged as phantom-crossing competitor. Cross-reference arXiv:2601.02284 and FA2 (μ sign).
